configuration: verification/cheapAML_box/input: a 100x100 box on a spherical polar grid of 0.25 degree cells starting at 30N, decomposed into eight tiles of 50x25, with a SINGLE ocean level 1000 m thick over topog.box, so the ocean is a slab whose only job is to provide a sea-surface temperature; on top of it runs pkg/cheapaml, a two-dimensional atmospheric mixed layer of depth cheapaml_h=1000 m that carries its own air temperature and humidity, advects and diffuses them, and computes the air-sea fluxes itself with FluxFormula='COARE3', useRelativeWind=.TRUE. (so the stress is computed from the wind relative to the ocean current), useFreshWaterFlux=.TRUE. and useFluxLimit=.TRUE. (which selects the flux-limited third-order direct-space-time scheme, GAD_DST3FL_ADV_X/Y, for the atmospheric advection instead of centred second order), with cheapaml_ntim=5 atmospheric sub-steps per ocean step and a cheapaml_mask_width=4 relaxation frame at the lateral boundaries; the ocean itself is simple, viscAh=500, diffKhT=diffKhS=200, tempAdvScheme=33, staggerTimeStep, a linear equation of state and celsius2K=273.16, with PARM02 left entirely empty so cg2d runs on its defaults. The deck runs endTime=28800 s at deltaT=1200 s, 24 steps (eight hours); the window here is 48 steps, sixteen hours, twice the deck's own.. Graded: every <field>.<final iteration>.data written by the end-of-run state dump (the prognostic fields of write_state.F and of the packages in use), read with the shape and precision of the .meta sidecar; the initial-state dump and the log are not graded.
observable: every graded field of the final state dump after 48 steps (T and the other prognostic and package fields written at the final iteration), all cells
default_vs_upstream: nTimeSteps 48 (upstream 24); dumpFreq, pChkptFreq, chkptFreq 0 with dumpInitAndLast; writeBinaryPrec 64; useSingleCpuIO; useMNC=.FALSE. in data.pkg, useDiagnostics=.FALSE. in data.pkg
variant: ic/variant is ic/nominal with cheapaml_h=1000.0000000000002 in data.cheapaml instead of 1000, replacing the deck's own line: two ulps of the graded precision (2.3e-16 relative) on a parameter that enters the tendency from the first step, verified to be a distinct double, so the two runs differ at round-off level without leaving the round-off floor; the recorded spread is the check's real sensitivity under this rule.

comparison.files: every <field>.<iteration>.data at the final iteration of the reference, minus not_graded; the candidate must have the same set at the same iteration
comparison.format: raw big-endian IEEE floating point as written by pkg/mdsio (writeBinaryPrec=64), precision and dimensions from the .meta sidecar

evidence.floor_how: the largest absolute difference over all graded values (floor) and the largest fraction of the check's bound |c - r| <= 1e-10 + 1e-08|r| used by any graded value (in PHL) between the optimised gfortran build (linux_amd64_gfortran optfile, -O3) and the IEEE build of the same source (genmake2 -ieee, -O0 -ffloat-store) on the nominal deck, run natively on the x86_64 host on 2026-09-02; the two builds pass each other under this rule

faults.how: same optimised build and deck as the reference with one parameter changed, compared under the check's own rule (atol 1e-10, rtol 1e-08, the check's exclusions applied), natively on the x86_64 host on 2026-09-02

warrant: The observable is every cell of every prognostic field in the final state dump, compared as |c - r| <= 1e-10 + 1e-08|r|; the relative part is the working bound because the graded fields span many orders of magnitude, the absolute part covers cells at or near zero. The observable is every cell of U, V, W, T, S and Eta of the ocean plus the pkg/cheapaml state, U, V, W, T, S, Eta and the hydrostatic pressure, of the final dump under |c - r| <= 1e-10 + 1e-8|r|; pkg/cheapaml's own prognostic air temperature and humidity are NOT graded, because the package writes them only under its writeDbug flag and otherwise carries them solely in its pickup, which the generator suppresses by setting pChkptFreq=chkptFreq=0, so the atmosphere is tested only through the fluxes it imposes on the ocean, which is nevertheless a tight coupling because the ocean is a single slab whose temperature is driven by nothing else. The bound is physical because sixteen hours of a 0.25 degree box whose ocean is a single 1000 m slab is a smooth, diffusively controlled adjustment: the ocean barely moves, the atmospheric mixed layer relaxes towards equilibrium with it under a limited advection scheme, and there is no baroclinic instability, no convective adjustment, no freezing and no moving cell heights anywhere in the deck. The flux limiter selected by useFluxLimit is the ordinary Lipschitz-continuous DST3 limiter of pkg/generic_advdiff, built from min and max of continuous quantities, so it does not switch under a round-off perturbation. THE ONE GENUINE THRESHOLD IN THIS CHECK, and a reviewer must know about it, is inside COARE3: pkg/cheapaml/cheapaml_coare3_flux.F computes a first-guess Monin-Obukhov stability parameter zetu and then branches, 'IF (zetu .GT. 50.) nits=1 ELSE nits=3', choosing between one and three iterations of the flux algorithm. That is a discrete switch on a continuous quantity: a cell sitting within round-off of zetu=50 would take a different number of iterations in the nominal and the variant run and its fluxes would differ by a finite amount, not by round-off. zetu=50 is an extremely stable boundary layer, far outside anything a 30N to 55N ocean box with a modest air-sea temperature difference should produce, and the switch is evaluated 10000 times per sub-step and five sub-steps per step, so if it can fire it will fire early; that is why the window is only twice the deck's own rather than the four or five times used elsewhere. If the measured spread jumps, this is the mechanism, and the response is to shorten the window to the deck's 24 steps or to drop the check, not to loosen the bound. (The two other branches in the same routine, on Du greater than 10 and 18 m/s for the Charnock parameter, are continuous at their breakpoints, so they are kinks rather than jumps and are harmless.) The variant is cheapaml_h=1000, set explicitly in CHEAPAML_CONST of data.cheapaml, and it is the right probe because it is the parameter that defines this package: cheapaml_readparms.F sets hm=1/cheapaml_h and cheapaml_init_varia.F fills the cheapHgrid array with it, so it divides every atmospheric temperature and humidity tendency from the first sub-step of the first step and reaches the ocean through the fluxes immediately. It is achievable because the run is one process with the tiles swept in a fixed order (GLOBAL_SUM_ORDER_TILES), so every reduction and every solver sweep is deterministic and two correct builds of the same source differ only by round-off amplified through the steps of the integration; the nominal-versus-variant spread that selfcheck records is the measurement of that amplification under this exact rule, and the bound is finalised against it with the human. Faults: Getting a COARE3 stability function or a transfer coefficient wrong changes the turbulent heat flux by tens of per cent over the whole box, which within sixteen hours changes the air temperature of a 1000 m mixed layer by tenths of a kelvin and the sea-surface temperature by a smaller but coherent amount. Dropping useRelativeWind and computing the stress from the absolute wind instead changes the momentum flux by the ratio of the current to the wind speed, per cent. Getting the cheapaml_ntim sub-stepping wrong, taking four sub-steps instead of five or applying the ocean tendency once per sub-step instead of once per step, changes the fluxes by tens of per cent. Dividing by the wrong mixed-layer depth (hm = 1/cheapaml_h in cheapaml_readparms.F) scales every atmospheric tendency. Single precision gives about 1e-7 relative. The expensive path under test is pkg/cheapaml: cheapaml.F and cheapaml_timestep.F, which run cheapaml_ntim=5 sub-steps per model step, and above all cheapaml_coare3_flux.F, which for every one of the 10000 surface cells on every sub-step evaluates the COARE3 bulk algorithm with its Monin-Obukhov iteration (one or three passes of logarithms, powers and stability functions); this transcendental work, not the ocean, is what makes this the most expensive check per grid point in the module and it is the reason the estimated run time is the largest of the twenty added here despite the tiny 100x100x1 grid.. The nominal-versus-variant spread recorded by selfcheck is the measurement of the round-off amplification under this exact rule, and the bound is finalised against it with the human.
